build_mae_vit_large: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT large model with 1024 embed dim and 24 transformer blocks for audio MAE
build_mae_vit_base: build a MaskedAutoencoderViT base model with 768 embed dim and 12 transformer blocks for audio MAE
create_forward_encoder: create a forward pass through the encoder with random masking on spectrogram patches
create_forward_decoder: create a forward pass through the decoder to reconstruct masked spectrogram patches
create_random_masking_2d: create 2D spectrogram masking by independently masking time and frequency dimensions with configurable probabilities
